headline: Frontier Base Lines Grow Increasingly Unsettled
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the sharpest movement has gathered at WeatheredExpanseHex, where daily base events have risen to twenty-one, six in the latest two hours, while the ledger remains divided four Warden, four Colonial, and one neutral. FishermansRowHex has likewise quickened to fifteen events in twenty-four hours and nine in two, though all nine strategic bases currently stand Colonial. FarranacCoastHex shows ten daily events, including five in the last six hours, with its eleven bases now entirely Colonial; its casualty pace, however, is cooling. LinnMercyHex has quieted from the earlier report’s seventeen daily events to eight, but one base remains neutral among ten Colonial holdings and fresh activity was recorded at the cutoff. StonecradleHex is still split six Colonial to three Warden, with twelve daily events, although none arrived in the latest two hours. StlicanShelfHex retains its five-to-four division and five daily events, without fresh turnover in six hours. GutterHex has also become a lively Warden-held sector, posting ten daily events and five in two hours. The heaviest fighting by casualties is concentrated in Weathered, Stonecradle, and the increasingly active MooringCountyHex, where enlistments and losses are accelerating.
